result:
**Decision: CONTINUE.** Round 164 fixes Saba's two bugs (SABA-B-1 and SABA-B-2), starting from commit `0e4287f`, which gate 163 published.

**Round 163 closed:** C passed it with real browser checks (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` true) and found 0 bugs, so V-3c-3a is done (მზადაა). The only blocked check was the fake-Bearer 403, because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

**Round 164 task (`current-task.md`):**
- **SABA-B-1 (Medium), the envelope control is hard to see.** I reproduced it in Chromium. The line, the handle, the waveform and the selected clip header are all the same brass colour. The line drops to 1.74:1 contrast, the handle to 1.88:1, and the handle has no hover style.
  - **Fix:** a white line on a dark 4 px halo, and a white 10 px handle with a dark border that grows to 1.25× on hover. When I simulated this in the page (no source change), contrast reached 15.62:1.
  - It should still hold after DUX-R-5 makes the waveforms neutral. That stage will re-check it.
- **SABA-B-2 (Low, fixed now), the overview corners have gaps.** The cause is a 2 px rounded frame inside the overview's 6 px rounded box, which cuts its corners. The fix is to give the frame the same 6 px radius; nothing changes size.
  - The corner-gap count I wrote for C is 3/13/3/15 per corner on the current build and 1/0/1/0 with the fix simulated.
- **Scope:** five files A may change (the two components, two test files, and the status line of doc 132) plus a new doc 133. 977 other files are frozen, and the purchase and auth files are protected. A adds two test locks and runs four mutations.
- **What C checks:** the line and handle reach at least 3:1 in every clip state (pixel-measured), the corner gaps are gone, the envelope still works (including real audio at gain 0), the page layout stays within ±1 px, and `/studio-lab` still opens anonymously.

**Planning files and backlog:**
- `tasks/round-163.md` is an exact copy of the previous task. I also saved before-copies of the task, `b-next.json`, `feature-status.md` and `backlog.json`.
- **Saba's decision files arrived**, and I recorded them in `backlog.json`:
  - ABL-R-1/2/3/4/7/8/9/10/11/12/13/14/15/18 and DUX-R-1…9 are approved.
  - The new **REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS** queue comes after VISUAL-A and before T12-ADVANCED. Its order is my ruling and Saba can veto it: each review keeps its own order, and the two alternate, starting with ABL-R-7.
  - DUX-R-5 becomes its own VISUAL-A stage before M1.
  - V-2b-DISPLAY is closed as "no serif". No code work is needed, because Cormorant isn't loaded in Studio.
  - B-R107-ENTER-ON-BODY is closed as intended behaviour.
  - ABL-R-5/16/17 still wait for Saba.
- I recorded ROOT-RECON-MARKER-ENTER and ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS. Two Lows from the gate-163 review went into `deferred_low_polish`.
- `feature-status.md` was updated with targeted edits; `b-round-163.md` and `b-next.json` are written.

**Next:**
- Round 165 is ROOT-RECON-MARKER-ENTER: a test first, and a fix only if the bug reproduces.
- Round 166 is V-3c-3b.
- The regression round takes priority from 2026-10-27.
- The frontend-architect checkpoint request is still unanswered. It doesn't block these rounds, but it is needed before V-3c-4.

The advisor tool was available, and I used it twice. Its final review made me fix the corner-gap check so it ignores normal edge smoothing, and confirm that live playback applies the envelope. I changed no app source; the store tree is clean.
